title: Make a server-streaming gRPC call — grpc_stream
code: # A test server, from zuhttp's mock transport: it streams two messages # and ends with status OK. fake <- zuhttp::zu_mock_transport(function(req) {   zuhttp::zu_response(     200L,     headers = c("content-type" = "application/grpc+proto"),     body = as.raw(c(0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0x61, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0x62)),     trailers = c("grpc-status" = "0")   ) }) ch <- grpc_channel(   "http://localhost:50051",   client = zuhttp::zu_client(transport = fake) ) st <- grpc_stream(ch, "/grpc.testing.TestService/StreamingOutputCall", raw()) while (!is.null(m <- st$next_message())) print(rawToChar(m)) #> [1] "a" #> [1] "b" st$status() #> [1] "OK"

what: zugrpc: Client for 'gRPC' Remote Procedure Calls over 'HTTP/2' — zugrpc-package
title: zugrpc: Client for 'gRPC' Remote Procedure Calls over 'HTTP/2' — zugrpc-package
text: client 'gRPC' remote procedure calls, written 'R' top 'HTTP/2' requests 'zuhttp' makes. Implements 'gRPC' wire protocol: length-prefixed messages, request headers metadata, deadlines, cancellation, call status carried 'HTTP' trailers, error details decoded structured conditions. Supports unary server-streaming calls, streamed responses read one message time. Messages encoded decoded caller, example 'zuproto'.
